title: MoSSP: A Momentum-Based Single-Loop Stochastic Penalty Method for Nonconvex Constrained DC-regularized Optimization
abstract:
In this paper, we study a structured class of nonconvex constrained stochastic problems with difference-of-convex (DC) regularization, where the feasible set is possibly nonconvex and the concave part of the DC regularizer is allowed to be nonsmooth.
The fundamental challenge lies in maintaining feasibility for nonconvex constraints while achieving favorable oracle complexity.
Although single-loop algorithms efficiently solve unconstrained DC optimization problems, their potential for constrained optimization with DC structure remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we develop **MoSSP**, a **Mo**mentum-based **S**ingle-loop **S**tochastic **P**enalty method for such problems with provable complexity guarantees. The key idea is to apply a single stochastic proximal-gradient step to the Moreau envelope of the penalty plus the convex DC part, with the concave part's proximal mapping computed in parallel. We derive two algorithm variants: a Polyak-momentum version with $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$ oracle complexity for finding stochastic $\varepsilon$-KKT points, and an improved $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ version incorporating recursive momentum. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.
problem: Nonconvex constrained stochastic optimization with difference-of-convex regularization and possibly nonconvex feasible sets is challenging while maintaining feasibility and achieving favorable oracle complexity.
approach: Develops MoSSP, a momentum-based single-loop stochastic penalty method applying proximal-gradient step to Moreau envelope with polylogarithmic variants achieving O(ε^{-4}) and improved O(ε^{-3}) oracle complexity.
contribution: Provides provable complexity guarantees for finding stochastic ε-KKT points in constrained DC optimization.
